blocks.text: STA. BARBARA, Pangasinan — Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) acting President and Chief Executive Officer Beverly Lorraine Ho thinks the benefit packages for young people and children with disabilities need to be maximized. Ho said they aim to enroll children in YAKAP through school-based caravans to give them access to primary care. “We want to cover as much as possible the majority of students who are studying in schools,” the PhilHealth chief said. “It means that all children should have access to primary care.
